GradGuard is Cornell's preferred insurer, for students on and off campus; covers theft, fire, smoke, vandalism and more; no price published

GradGuard features: no rate increase on claim, no electronics sub-limits, no depreciation penalty, worldwide property, personal liability if you damage your residence, sign-up in Housing and Dining Portal
SafeButler Ithaca: about $76 a year (about $6 a month); $5 and $10 a month for ages 18-24, September 11, 2026; $108-$267 a year for a 20-year-old, 8 carriers
